Katsina State Governor Dikko Radda has highlighted his administration’s development projects and empowerment programmes in Baure Local Government Area of the state as part of efforts to seek residents’ support for the All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. Radda made this known during the APC campaign rally in Baure on Saturday, where he urged residents to support President Bola Tinubu and the party’s candidates across all elective positions. The governor listed the interventions as water supply projects, provision of secondary schools, access to loans, federal employment opportunities and other schemes. He said the initiatives were aimed at improving the living conditions of residents and expanding economic opportunities across the state. Radda, who expressed satisfaction with the turnout at the rally, described residents of the Daura Emirate as loyal supporters of the APC, recalling their longstanding relationship with the party dating back to the administration of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Earlier, Zango thanked the people of Baure for what he described as their show of love and commitment to the party. He urged them to translate their support into votes for APC candidates, saying the party remained committed to addressing the needs and aspirations of the people. Radda further called on voters to consider honesty and respect when choosing their leaders, stressing that Katsina State deserved leaders who possessed such qualities. He also commended APC leaders, stakeholders and supporters in the local government for their contributions to the party’s mobilisation efforts. Faith Maji
